name: ship-tasks
description: Deliver explicitly invoked or selected Task Manager work safely through ShipTask.

interface.longDescription: Install ShipTask separately from the Task Manager connector, then deliver work through explicit $ship-tasks or natural language that names an existing Task or already selected Task Manager Project, Release, or current scope. A delivery verb alone does not route ordinary code, product, repository, or plugin fixes into ShipTask.
defaultPrompt: Deliver TM-123 to a verified terminal outcome
Deliver the selected Task Manager release
Create exactly one Task in Task Manager and immediately start delivering it
